schema.description: INTERFACE_SCHEMA. Identifies the module-interface contract this record implements.

module.description: Importable module name. The checker uses the requested module's __name__.

version.description: INTERFACE_VERSION. A major.minor.patch string such as 1.0.0.

owner_modules.description: OWNER_MODULES. Importable modules that define the public symbols. Parsed, not executed.

public_symbols.description: PUBLIC_SYMBOLS. Attribute names that must be defined in an owner module.

status.description: STATUS. An empty public_symbols list is valid only when STATUS is facade-only.

rules: schema, module, version, owner_modules, and public_symbols are required.
version must be a major.minor.patch string.
An empty public surface is accepted only when STATUS is facade-only.
Each public symbol must be defined in an owner module.
Importing the interface module must not start a server. The checker rejects a server-starting import without executing it.
